aura: Healing Effects on Allies are 50% as Effective
AoE Damage Dealt to Minions is 75% Effective
Nearby Enemy Minion Deaths Grant 6 Gold
Excess Critical Strike Chance gets converted to Adaptive Force
Melee champions gain Armor and Magic Resistance
All champions gain Presence of Mind

fastTravel.name: Frost Gates
fastTravel.text: Gates behind each Nexus send you from base to just in front of your outer turret, or your inhibitor turret once the outer turret falls. They only go one way, out of base.

fastTravel.name: Portals
fastTravel.text: One pair sends you out of base, one way only. A second pair by the side wall goes both ways. Entering takes a short channel that damage interrupts.

fastTravel.name: Cannon Launchers
fastTravel.text: Launchers next to each base fire you out into the lane.

fastTravel.name: Hex gates and Acceleration Pads
fastTravel.text: Hex gates (manholes on the Zaun side) send you out of base. Acceleration Pads give 25% bonus Move Speed for 1 second.
